$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target pairs with. CI rebuilds it from
the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
'patchSets' names the patch sets this build takes on top of common, as
directories under the patch submodule's patches/<version>/. klimt takes
none: HyperOS on this device has no KDP/RKP/DEFEX, so it builds against a
tree carrying only common, whose staged late-load the bootstrap helper
